description: This file contains utility functions for the Drupal Views module, including query string parsing, view argument extraction, and URL path manipulation.

methods.name: parseQueryString
methods.description: Parses a query string into a key-value map, ignoring the 'q' parameter.

methods.name: parseViewArgs
methods.description: Returns view arguments and path based on a URL and view path.

methods.name: pathPortion
methods.description: Removes protocol and domain from a URL, returning the path portion.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Extracts the internal path from a URL, handling query parameters and hash fragments.
